title: realLaunchReplay sets STOP_LOSS_PERCENT, which src never reads (src reads STOP_LOSS_PCT), so its "30% stop-loss" exit comes from the operator's .env or the default 25, and every replay accepts any sell row, so the per-fixture exit path (partial-sell, trailing-stop, stop-loss) is never asserted

evidence.note: the stop-loss is parseFloat(process.env.STOP_LOSS_PCT || '25'); src reads STOP_LOSS_PCT only (config.ts:67 declares it)

evidence.ref: git grep -n STOP_LOSS 23a64617dca167976adc4645fed0e2c69e384820 -- src scripts .env.example test
evidence.note: STOP_LOSS_PERCENT appears only in realLaunchReplay.fork.test.ts:75 and :384; captureRehearsal, deliberateBuyReplay and exitStatePersistence set STOP_LOSS_PCT (the read name)
waitForSellRow accepts any sell or partial_sell row with amount_out
V2 assertion: at least one such row; the fixture's expectedExitPath (partial-sell for LADYS, trailing-stop for BOBO) is not checked
V3 assertion: the same; expectedExitPath stop-loss (PEPE) is not checked
expectedExitPath "trailing-stop" (read into the test title only, :470)

sibling_sites_checked: Every env key set by a fork file (grep process.env.X = over test/fork) against the keys src reads (git grep process.env over src): STOP_LOSS_PERCENT is the only key set that src never reads. PARTIAL_SELL_TARGETS, TRAILING_STOP_PCT, MAX_POSITION_SIZE, MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS, SNIPE_COOLDOWN_MS, DAILY_LOSS_PCT, MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE and DB_PATH are read by src. captureRehearsal asserts the stop-loss reason explicitly (:464-478); realLaunchReplay is the only replay that leaves the exit path unasserted.
severity_rationale: S2: the replays are the closest real-path exit proof; with the exit path unasserted a regression that breaks the partial-tier or trailing branch (the money-taking exits) passes as long as any other exit eventually sells, and the stop threshold silently depends on the operator's .env.
recommendation: Phase 25 (first fork execution): set STOP_LOSS_PCT (the read name), assert the exit reason per fixture (partial_sell row for the partial-sell fixture, reason trailing-stop / stop-loss for the others, as captureRehearsal does), and fail the test when the reason differs.
affected_cases: eth-v2-tp (v2, partial-sell) drives the REAL handler
eth-v2-partial (v2, trailing-stop) drives the REAL handler
eth-v3-trailing (v3, stop-loss) drives the REAL handler
escaped_regression: Break the 2x partial-sell tier in pollExitStrategy (for example skip getUnfilledTiers): the LADYS replay still passes because the trailing stop or the 30-minute urgency exit later writes a sell row, so a release that never takes profit at 2x ships green.
